title: Keto Date Night Board
h1: Keto Date Night Board for Two
seo_title: Keto Date Night Charcuterie Board for Two: Shopping & Plan
description: A keto date night board for two: brie, Manchego, prosciutto, soppressata, endive, strawberries, blackberries, macadamia nuts and 90% dark chocolate.
hook: A romantic spread with a dark-chocolate finish: a keto dinner for two that still feels like a treat.
why: Endive leaves are the elegant keto cracker: crisp, slightly bitter and shaped like a spoon for brie. Manchego and soppressata give the board a Spanish note, and prosciutto adds the silky one.
The dessert is built in: strawberries, blackberries and three squares of 90% dark chocolate, which is low in sugar but rich. Macadamia nuts add buttery crunch.

timeline.what: Take the manchego out of the fridge.
Take out the brie. Separate the endive leaves; rinse and dry the berries.
Take out the prosciutto and soppressata.
Arrange the board; break the chocolate into squares.

faq.q: What's a keto dessert for date night?
faq.a: Berries with a few squares of 90% dark chocolate, or mascarpone with berries. This board finishes with the first.

faq.q: What do you use instead of crackers?
faq.a: Belgian endive leaves. They hold soft cheese like a spoon and add crunch.
About 8 g net carbs per serving.
